info.title: Analytics OCS API
info.description: Analytics OCS v1. Additional endpoints wrap existing services and permissions using ordinary Nextcloud authentication. See docs/ocs-reports-api-v1.md for native JSON, partial updates, secret handling, Chart.js merge precedence and sequential retry limitations.

post.summary: Create analytics report from a data file

fileId.description: ID of the file to import

get.description:
Includes reports shared with the user, their groups, or through report folders. Excludes public-link-only and panorama-only access. Returns parent and type. Groups are omitted by default; includeGroups=true includes all accessible nested groups. No inaccessible ancestors are fetched.

Reports and datasets are different objects; several reports can reference the same dataset. With includeGroups enabled, type 0 identifies a navigation group, not a renderable report. Traverse parent IDs recursively, including nested descendants, with a visited-ID set; parent 0/null denotes the root. Resolve duplicate group names by ancestry. Missing ancestors may be inaccessible. Report groups and dataset groups are separate namespaces. To find datasets used under a report group, deduplicate nonzero dataset IDs from descendant reports and check owned dataset details.

parameters.name: includeGroups
parameters.description: Include accessible navigation groups (type 0), at every nesting level. Follow parent IDs within this resource namespace; groups are not data-bearing items.

Operations are independent; there is no transaction across calls. Retain returned IDs when a later operation fails. After an uncertain creation response, inspect existing objects before retrying: names are not unique and retrying can create duplicates.

Use native Analytics chart names, not arbitrary Chart.js type names. For a table-only report set visualization to table; chart is not table. Stored reports default to type 2. Live sources require an enabled provider type and dataset 0; link contains flat provider settings, not a sourceOptions wrapper. Retain returned report IDs for Panorama composition.

Includes reports shared with the user, their groups, or through report folders. Excludes public-link-only and panorama-only access.

Shared-safe metadata can contain native options encoded as JSON strings. Access to a shared report does not grant access to its editable source configuration or its underlying dataset.

put.description:
Authenticated native configuration. Owner-only writes. Omitted fields retain saved values; supplied option objects replace them. See docs/ocs-reports-api-v1.md for clearing, secret preservation and sequential retry semantics.

Read editable configuration immediately before updating. type and dataset are immutable. Supplied chartoptions, dataoptions, filteroptions and tableoptions replace complete values rather than merging nested keys; preserve unrelated settings and use null to clear. link replaces visible source settings while retaining omitted write-only settings; link:null clears all settings including credentials. Unsupported report-level chart values return HTTP 400 and must be corrected before retrying.

get.description:
Includes reports shared with the user, their groups, or through report folders. Excludes public-link-only and panorama-only access. Uses the report viewer backend pipeline, including saved filters, variables, sorting and transformations. No temporary filter overrides. Browser-side formatting and pivots are not rendered. Datasource failures use the payload error field.

Reads viewer backend data with saved filters and transformations and may execute the configured source. It does not render a chart. A provider error is a failed data read, not an empty dataset.

parameters.name: reportId
parameters.description: Accessible report ID; folders are not reports

get.description:
List owned datasets with their ID, name, column labels, parent and type. Shared reports do not grant dataset write access. The legacy V3 dataset response is unchanged. Returns parent and type. Groups are omitted by default; includeGroups=true includes all accessible nested groups. No inaccessible ancestors are fetched.

Use this endpoint to discover datasets under a dataset navigation group, rather than inferring one dataset per report. With includeGroups enabled, type 0 identifies a group, not a data-bearing dataset. Recursively traverse parent IDs with a visited-ID set; parent 0/null denotes the root. Resolve duplicate names by ancestry and include nested descendants. Never use a group ID as a dataset ID. Dataset groups are separate from report groups. Read dataset details before choosing legacy-row or flexible-record operations or shared filter mappings.

Creates an owned dataset, not a live connection to another application. Data copied from another application is a snapshot unless a separately configured existing provider supplies ongoing updates.

Delegates to the existing V4 external API. Requires ownership of a legacy dataset; flexible datasets are rejected. Application errors retain HTTP 200 and success=false with error.code and error.message in ocs.data (9002 invalid input, 9003 missing or unauthorized dataset, 9004 unsupported storage mode). Inspect success, not only ocs.meta. The URL datasetId takes precedence over body parameters.

For legacy storage only; read dataset details first. Existing dimension identities are overwritten. Copying values from another application creates a snapshot, not a live connection. Send the complete intended data rather than a truncated preview.

get.description:
Existing enabled built-in/registered providers and their native option definitions. No new source discovery integration.

Returns enabled provider IDs and native option/report templates. Use these templates to configure existing providers; creating a dataset or saving a dataload does not establish a new cross-application integration.

Owner-only editable configuration without text-variable expansion; source credentials/unknown settings and remote URLs are write-only. Existing shared metadata reads are unchanged.

Read this owner-only configuration before updating. Native options are objects/arrays. Write-only source settings are omitted; omission from a read response does not mean that a setting is absent. Preserve unrelated options when replacing an option object.

Use existing, accessible report IDs, for example IDs returned by separate report creation calls. Choose a layout with enough slots for every tile. post.description:
Existing owner-only flexible record upsert; keys are stable c_<id> references. See docs/flexible-storage-api-v1.md for limits, identity and values.

For flexible_shared storage only. Read the current schema first and use stable column refs with schemaVersion. Full records replace values for existing dimension identities; nullable omissions become null. Use strings for decimal values to preserve precision.

records.summary: Upsert complete records with stable column refs

put.description: Replace one record in an owned flexible_shared dataset. Read the dataset schema and current record values first. Supply schemaVersion and a complete values object using stable column refs; this is a replacement, not a partial field update. Preserve decimal precision with strings. HTTP 409 indicates a stale schema or identity conflict; refresh the relevant state before retrying. See docs/flexible-storage-api-v1.md.

post.description: Read an owned flexible_shared dataset using its native query. This POST operation is read-only. Read the schema first and use actual stable column refs. Supports raw or grouped queries with native filters, sorting and measures. Use backend limit/offset for record pagination; a page or sample is not the complete dataset or a complete aggregate. See docs/flexible-storage-api-v1.md for query formats and limits.

schema.description: Existing flexible raw/grouped query: columns, dimensions, measures, filters, sort, aggregate, timeAggregation, topN, limit<=1000 and offset. See docs/flexible-storage-api-v1.md.

dataset.description: Creation: 0 creates an internal dataset for type=2; nonzero requires an owned dataset. Immutable on update.

visualization.description: Native display mode: chart, table, or ct (chart and table). For a table-only report use visualization:"table", not chart:"table".

chart.description: Analytics chart type; empty defaults to column. For a solid pie use doughnut with chartoptions.cutout=0. Unsupported values are rejected with HTTP 400. These are report-level Analytics names: use column for bars, doughnut for pie-style distributions, and visualization:"table" for tables. The restriction does not apply to per-series Chart.js types in dataoptions.

chartoptions.description: Native JSON; supplied field replaces its saved counterpart. null clears it. Omitted fields retain saved values. Chart.js 4 JSON options remain flexible; JavaScript and callbacks are unsupported. Legend visibility is plugins.legend.display, not legend.display. __analytics_gui, analyticsModel and scales.secondary have GUI precedence. Read current configuration and preserve unrelated nested options before replacement.

PanoramaTile.description: Native tile passed through PanoramaService. type 0: report ID; type 1: text; type 2: picture file ID. Viewer access rules are unchanged.

layoutId.description: Layout slot counts: 0=0, 1=3, 2=3, 3=4, 4=6, 5=2, 6=1. Layout 5 is two stacked full-width panels. Layout 1 has two side-by-side upper slots plus one full-width lower slot; use null for an empty slot. Layout 3 is a 2x2 grid. There is no dedicated two-side-by-side-only layout. Choose enough slots for all tiles; layout 5 cannot display three or four reports.

reports.description: Ordered tiles corresponding to layout slots; null represents an empty slot. Tile type 0 uses an accessible report ID, type 1 contains text, and type 2 uses an accessible PNG/JPEG file ID.

mappings.description: Mappings reference reports included as Panorama tiles and their actual dimension labels or stable column refs. Read report data/dataset schema to identify compatible dimensions before constructing a shared filter.

pages.description: Complete ordered page configuration. Supplied arrays replace all pages; [] clears pages and null is invalid. Preserve unrelated pages/tiles when updating.

filters.description: Complete shared-filter configuration. Supplied arrays replace all filters; [] or null clears filters. Map enabled filters to compatible dimensions of report tiles.
